meanings.Crowd Control: Stuns, roots, slows or otherwise locks enemies down.
meanings.Burst: Deletes one target with a quick combo.
meanings.Mobile: Has dashes, blinks or speed to move around the fight.
meanings.Auto-attack: Deals most of its damage with basic attacks.
meanings.Hypercarry: Grows into a damage threat that carries late fights.
meanings.Dive: Jumps onto targets in the enemy backline.
meanings.Sustained Damage: Keeps dealing damage over a long fight.
meanings.Summon: Fights alongside pets, clones or other units.
meanings.Battlecaster: A mage who fights up close with a steady stream of spells.
meanings.Damage-over-Time: Damages through burns, poisons and other effects over time.
meanings.Shapeshift: Changes form to swap between sets of abilities.
meanings.Enchanter: Strengthens allies with heals, shields and buffs.
meanings.Catcher: Locks down enemies who walk into their traps and hooks.
meanings.Juggernaut: Slow, hard to kill and hits hard up close.
meanings.Diver: Jumps onto a target and stays on them.
meanings.Battlemage: Stays in the fight and deals damage over time.
meanings.Marksman: Steady damage from range with basic attacks.
meanings.Assassin: Gets in, kills a squishy target, gets out.
meanings.Skirmisher: Wins long close-range fights with strong duelling.
meanings.Vanguard: Starts fights by diving in with crowd control.
meanings.Warden: Protects allies and peels for them.
